requirements.draft_code: PR #13 adds multiple RF-center focus and pan/follow semantics which are not in main.

requirements.regression_gate: Exercise Köln/default, map drag, RF 4-plane focus, nearest/fit/follow, small viewport list/legend and selected aircraft persistence without GPS-like jumps.

requirements.main_code: Main has no dedicated flight_route_lookup.py or flight_journey.js in its pinned tree.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 implements opt-in single-callsign route lookup, provider provenance and unknown schedule fallback.
gaps: Live provider route accuracy and per-flight matching unverified; provider route does not prove actual individual flight nor schedule.
requirements.regression_gate: Test callsign mismatch, unknown route/times, provider license/rate limits and verified departure/arrival fields; never infer schedule from ADS-B timestamp.

requirements.main_code: Main receiver controller supports explicit start/stop/status and remote vs direct vs Linux service modes.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 adds independent Radio Load and responsive receiver UI; pairing fixes remain Draft.
gaps: Reported native pairing failure under #13 is not certified fixed on actual Pop!_OS machine; GUI load is not proof of RF signal.
requirements.regression_gate: Verify paired/absent/failed bridge, accurate Radio Load and Internet Load, stop/fail close behavior, and physical SDR release on native desktop.

requirements.main_code: Offline DE/TR city list, manual coordinates and saved location helpers exist; optional web geocoding has API dependency.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 adds optional user-imported offline MBTiles, not present in main.
gaps: Whole-country region/city selection and map-tile offline availability need user-device validation; online geocoding is not offline.
requirements.regression_gate: Offline DE/TR region/city/manual GPS search, saved place across relaunch, optional MBTiles local import and no implicit antenna activation.

requirements.main_code: Main has aircraft icon/altitude UI, basic info panels and source layer overlay.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 adds resizable 580px side panel and persistent multi-layer selection; installed GUI is unverified.
gaps: Text/UI event tests and screenshots do not replace Wayland/Qt/mobile accessibility and resize checks.
requirements.regression_gate: Resize desktop and mobile panels, open popups/Circles, keyboard focus, overlays and simultaneous model/aircraft selection without occlusion.

requirements.main_code: Main implements showRfCoverage and independent airplane feeds but does not establish the requested RF On-only-localization separation.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 contains RF OFF solver behavior checks and independent model controls.
gaps: Default checkbox semantics across startup/native/PWA and unaffected ADS-B/Internet tracking not hardware verified.
requirements.regression_gate: Toggle RF On OFF while simultaneous local readsb and Internet aircraft are streaming; assert ONLY localization models stop, aircraft count and receiver ownership do not.

requirements.main_code: Main solver permits region with 3 RF aircraft and draws at most six rings; this is not the requested 4+ independent aircraft five-model contract.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 implements five modes and distinct 4-ICAO hard minimum; no release or hardware sign-off.
gaps: Main-to-draft behavior delta requires coordinator sign-off; five-model persistence/performance not real RF verified.
requirements.regression_gate: At least four distinct genuine independently positioned RF ICAOs, arbitrary order and successive epochs; test LIVE10/LIVE-X/BEST/HISTORY/HISTORY-BEST separately.

requirements.main_code: Main RF timing lab rejects synthetic/Internet sample events and does not claim receiver fix, TOA or distance; coverage uses horizon upper-bound not accuracy.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 advances constrained grids/weighted heuristics but still no measured TOA/MLAT.
gaps: No calibrated GPS accuracy, synchronised receivers, propagation TOA, PSF/Gaussian empirical validation or field truth.
requirements.regression_gate: Reject Internet/copy-derived RF constraints, do not expose range or accuracy; compare feasible-area model to independent surveyed position without promoting centroid to GPS.

requirements.main_code: Main RF lab retains bounded 4000 sample events and 64-item optional coverage history, clearly not a persistent full archive.
requirements.draft_code: PR #13 adds opt-in SQLite/IndexedDB history, session/page storage and write guards.
gaps: Persistence, privacy, bounded disk growth, long session cleanup and frame timestamps need device soak testing.
requirements.regression_gate: Run long synthetic and opt-in recorded sessions, bounded disk/eviction/pagination/restart, RF-only provenance with original times, no background capture.

requirements.main_code: main and immutable legacy ref pinned by rollback script and version check; two Draft PRs must remain intact.
